result.summary: The page appears visually consistent overall, but there is a minor layout issue where the 'Popular right now' section card is partially cut off at the bottom of the screen, and the category filter chips might benefit from horizontal scrolling indication.

issues.description: The last visible card in the 'Popular right now' section (showing a pizza with -20% discount) is partially cut off at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate bottom padding or margin so that list items are not truncated at the screen edge, or allow natural scrolling to reveal the full card.

issues.description: The horizontal category filter chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, etc.) do not have a clear visual indicator that they can be scrolled horizontally, which may confuse some users.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle visual cue such as a fading edge or an arrow to indicate that more categories are available by scrolling horizontally.
